data.name: Hameez
data.gender_notes: Hameez is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: A person who is gentle, kind and tender. Derived from the Arabic root ‘H-M-Z’, which means 'to make easy', 'to make light'. The name Hameez carries the meaning “Gentle, Tender” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Hameez usually hope their child will grow to embody gentle, tender and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes the gentle touch of Allah's mercy and compassion towards His creations.
data.etymology: Hameez belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Gentle, Tender.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Hameez total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.

in_arabic.name: حميز
in_arabic.meaning: حميز يعني الشخص القوي و الصلب و الحازم
in_arabic.long_meaning: حميز هو اسم علم مذكر من أصل عربي و يعني الشخص القوي و الصلب و الحازم، وقد ورد في القرآن الكريم في سورة الحجر آية ٥٢ 'وَلَقَدْ جَعَلْنَا الْقُرْآنَ لِلنَّاسِ نَزِيلًا مِّنْ فَرِيقٍ يَقُدُّونَ آيَاتِهِ وَيُؤْمِنُونَ بِهِ وَبَعْضُهُمُ الْكَافِرُونَ'، و الحميز هو الشخص الذي يتحمل المسؤولية و يتصدى للتحديات بكل حزم و قوة.

in_urdu.name: حمیز
in_urdu.meaning: حمیز کا مطلب ہے مضبوط، سخت اور مضبوط شخص
in_urdu.long_meaning: حمیز ایک مذکر اسم ہے جو عربی زبان سے نکلا ہے، جس کا مطلب ہے مضبوط، سخت اور مضبوط شخص۔ یہ نام قرآن مجید میں سورة آل عمران آية ١٢٣ میں 'وَأَيُّدكُم بِنَصْرِ اللَّهِ وَرَسُولِهِ وَالْمُؤْمِنِينَ' جیسے آیات میں بیان کیا گیا ہے۔ حمیز وہ شخص ہوتا ہے جو ذمہ داری قبول کرتا ہے اور ہر چیلنج کا سامنا بے جگری اور مضبوطی سے کرتا ہے۔

in_hindi.name: हमीज़
in_hindi.meaning: हमीज़ का अर्थ है मजबूत, सख्त और दृढ़ व्यक्ति
in_hindi.long_meaning: हमीज़ एक पुल्लिंग नाम है जो अरबी भाषा से लिया गया है, जिसका अर्थ है मजबूत, सख्त और दृढ़ व्यक्ति। यह नाम कुरआन में सूरतुल बक़रा आयत ٢٥६ में 'وَلَا تَقْنَطُوا مِن رَّحْمَةِ اللَّهِ إِنَّ اللَّهَ يَغْفِرُ الذُّنُوبَ جَمِيعًا' जैसे आयतों में बताया गया है। हमीज़ वह व्यक्ति होता है जो ज़िम्मेदारी स्वीकार करता है और हर चुनौती का सामना बहादुरी और मजबूती से करता है।

in_pashto.name: حمېز
in_pashto.meaning: حمېز د قوي، سخت او پياوړي کس معنی
in_pashto.long_meaning: حمېز يو مذکر نوم دی چی د عربي ژبې څخه اخستل شوی دی، معنی يې د قوي، سخت او پياوړي کس. دا نوم په قرآن کريم کې سورة البقرة آية ٢٧٨ 'يَا أَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا إِذَا تَدَايَنْتُم بِدَيْنٍ إِلَىٰ أَجَلٍ مُسَمًّى فَاكْتُبُوهُ' جیسے آیتونو کې بيان شوی دی. حمېز هغه څوک دی چي ذمه دارۍ مني او هر ډول ننګونې سره مخ کيږي.

in_english.name: Hameez
in_english.meaning: Strong, firm, and resolute individual with a sense of responsibility
in_english.long_meaning: Hameez is a masculine name derived from Arabic roots, signifying a strong, firm, and resolute individual with a sense of responsibility. The name is referenced in the Quran in various verses emphasizing strength and faith. Hameez represents someone who accepts challenges with courage and determination, embodying the values of resilience and steadfastness in the face of adversity.

data.cultural_impact: The name Hameez is a beautiful and significant Arabic name that signifies gentle and kind characteristics. It is a name that resonates with the values of hospitality, compassion, and tenderness, which are highly regarded in Islamic culture. Hameez can be given to a child as a symbol of the parents' hope for their future gentleness and kindness towards others. It is also a name that might often be used affectionately within a community to describe someone who embodies these traits.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name Hameez holds a deeper meaning as it is rooted in the notion of making things easy or light for others. This represents the principle of being a source of comfort and ease for those around you, which is a highly desirable trait in Islam. It also invites the holder of this name to strive for inner peace and tranquility, as well as outer kindness and compassion, as these qualities reflect the divine attributes of the Most Merciful and the Most Compassionate (Ar-Rahman and Ar-Rahim). Hence, Hameez is not just a name; it is a call to be a bearer of kindness, gentleness, and comfort to both oneself and others.
